name: Omalet
author: Ravi Vasavan
description: Owlet Smart Sock 3 vitals on the Omarchy bar: heart rate, blood oxygen, battery, skin temperature, movement, sleep, and desktop alerts. Unofficial Owlet cloud API; not a substitute for the Owlet app.

barWidget.description: Sock 3 heart rate and oxygen pill with a vitals popup, optional camera still, and desktop alerts

schema.label: Show camera still
schema.description: Full-width snapshot above the vitals while the panel is open.

schema.label: Camera snapshot URL
schema.description: Optional JPEG URL (go2rtc, Home Assistant camera proxy, or similar). Fetched while the panel is open.
